product.name: ADVA Installment Platform
product.description: An online platform enabling users in Egypt to pay for various services through installment plans with flexible durations up to 60 months.

product.name: Car Maintenance Installment Service
product.description: A service allowing users to finance car maintenance expenses, including repairs, spare parts, and accessories, payable in installments within 48 hours.

product.name: Education Fees Installment Service
product.description: A service that allows users to pay school, university, and course fees in installments over flexible periods.

product.name: Medical Services Installment Service
product.description: A service enabling users to pay for medical procedures and health services in installments.

product.name: Wedding Services Installment Service
product.description: A service that allows users to finance wedding-related expenses through installment plans.

product.name: Home Finishing Installment Service
product.description: A service allowing users to pay for home finishing and renovation services in installments.
